sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
These Calbolg tokens are brought into play by removing +1 ATK/+1 DEF counter from [[TCG: OAL-099|Gyblog: Earth Father]]. 
You can raise an army by using cards such as [[TCG: OAL-071|Chillskin]] or by using [[TCG: OAL-041|Kilthane: Zhalia's Titan]]'s '''Armor Up''' ability or [[TCG: OAL-045|Scarlet: Good Friend]]'s '''Legendary Boost''' ability giving your side numerous +1 ATK/+1 DEF counters. You can then use [[TCG: OAL-035|Cherit: Living History]] to move them onto Gybolg. Then, Build your army of Calbolgs!
